title: Government
description: Ukraine is governed as a semi-presidential republic. The system of government shapes daily life through laws, services, and the citizen's relationship to the state. Its modern form dates to 1991 (independence) — and like all governments, it continues to evolve with its people.

title: Independence and statehood

title: Languages
description: Language in Ukraine: Ukrainian. Language carries the culture's humor, proverbs, and worldview — learning even greetings opens doors that stay closed to outsiders. Multilingual countries code-switch daily; visitors who try the local tongue are repaid with warmth.

title: Currency and money
description: Money in Ukraine: the hryvnia. Travelers should learn the denominations, the tipping customs, and whether cards or cash rule daily life. Exchange rates move, but the habit of checking prices in local terms keeps budgets honest.
